context_purpose: Housing offices and platforms confirm protected status to grant priority placement, deposit waiver or subsidy.

norm_violation_today.reason: Private landlords and platforms receive the full order with case details, which they do not need and which lets them match her across applications.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The housing office may need identity and case detail for subsidy payment and eligibility review, which a bare active-order proof cannot give.

transmission_check.reason: She volunteers the document to obtain a benefit, so a lighter proof is plausibly acceptable, though the subsidy office's rules are unclear.

context_purpose: The union election committee confirms voter eligibility and one vote per member in a strike ballot.

norm_violation_today.reason: Sign-in sheets and roster checks can be seen by HR or foremen, so the employer may learn who voted.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the committee only needs membership and once-only, though dispute audit of individual voters is harder.

transmission_check.reason: Union election procedure is set by its own rules and labour regulation, and I cannot say whether an anonymous proof is allowed.

context_purpose: The matching platform shows landlords that the tenant's work authorisation is currently valid, to justify a reduced deposit.

norm_violation_today.reason: The whole bundle of ARC, payslips and employer details is forwarded to every landlord contacted, beyond the one fact each needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Income stability and pay history cannot be judged from a validity bit, and landlords may still want ID for the lease.

transmission_check.reason: Platforms and landlords collect it voluntarily for screening, with no known duty requiring the full bundle.

context_purpose: The funeral home confirms the signer is entitled to authorise cremation of the deceased.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full household transcript exposes every relative's ID number, address and marital data, far beyond the signer's kin rank.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Disputes among equal-rank kin or unregistered relationships cannot be settled by a register-derived rank.

transmission_check.reason: Funeral operators may be expected to keep documentation, and I cannot say whether an attestation would satisfy regulators.

context_purpose: The temple lead wants assurance that one-day volunteers around children have no child-related conviction.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID copies and phone numbers sit in a personal notebook with no stated purpose, retention limit or protection.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A community attestation is only as reliable as the group's own check, so assurance is weaker than an official record.

transmission_check.reason: Informal child-safety screening with no known legal duty to hold the documents.

context_purpose: The dormitory operator confirms each resident is still lawfully employed by a sponsoring employer before renewing the bed.

norm_violation_today.reason: Keeping ARC copies and wage files in a binder may exceed need, but some registration duties may require a copy.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Fire-safety or police registers may still need ID details that a yes/no attestation omits.

transmission_check.reason: The operator may have registration duties requiring copies, and I cannot confirm what Taiwanese rules require.

context_purpose: The court controls entry so only the called lay-judge candidates reach the selection area.

norm_violation_today.reason: Scanned summons and ID in a desk attendance record may be unnecessary, but the court may legitimately record attendance.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The clerk must identify each person for selection and attendance, so anonymity only holds at the perimeter.

transmission_check.reason: Court attendance and identity-check rules may require visual ID, and I cannot say what the law demands.

context_purpose: The funeral home confirms the applicant is the highest-priority living next of kin before cremation.

norm_violation_today.reason: The full transcript reveals all relatives' IDs, addresses and marital history when only the applicant's rank matters.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Family disputes and facts outside the register cannot be resolved by the rank credential.

transmission_check.reason: The funeral home may be expected to retain a document copy, and I cannot confirm the rule.
